verdict.rationale: Riveter states that any project can be scheduled to monitor for changes and refresh as often as every minute. That is a genuine recurring background automation, not just one-off runs. Webhooks on run completion let results flow out without anyone watching, and competitor tracking is described as automatic. Missing for 10: API or docs detail on how schedules are configured and managed (cron or interval options, enabling via API or MCP), event-triggered automations beyond time-based refresh, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Schedule any project to monitor for changes and keep your data fresh.
For fast moving data like scores or election results, you can refresh as often as every minute.
Automatically track competitor pricing, features, positioning, vendors, and payment providers.
Pass webhook_url in the JSON body when starting a run and Riveter POSTs the full results to your URL when it finishes
